item.title: Microsoft outlines five principles for AI in education
item.description: Microsoft has outlined five principles for using AI in education, emphasizing safety, educator oversight, student learning and preparation for an AI-powered future.

item.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Posts Up to 3.7x Throughput Gain
item.description: NVIDIA says its Vera Rubin NVL72 preview delivered up to 3.7x the throughput of GB300 NVL72 in MLPerf Inference v6.1 tests.

item.title: Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA Form Alliance for Flexible AI Data Centers
item.description: Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA have launched an alliance focused on data centers that can adjust electricity use to support grid reliability and growth.
